content.short: Bitbond Token Tool is a token creation, management and multisend platform for ERC20/ERC1400 tokens and NFTs on EVM chains.
content.description: Bitbond Token Tool is a web3 application that lets you create, manage, and perform multisend operations for ERC20 and ERC1400 tokens as well as NFTs across major EVM networks. It relies on configurable smart contract templates that have been audited by CertiK, so you don't need to code your own contracts. The tool provides a user-friendly interface and, in its enterprise version, an API. Banks, corporations, tech firms, and content creators use Token Tool to launch their tokenization projects.
content.meta: Bitbond Token Tool enables ERC20/ERC1400 token creation, management and multisending. Discover Bitbond Token Tool and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
